model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 10 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.
